10:1.sourceText: Ἀνὴρ δέ τις ἐν Καισαρίᾳ ὀνόματι Κορνήλιος, ἑκατοντάρχης ἐκ σπείρης τῆς καλουμένης Ἰταλικῆς,
10:1.targetText: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was called the Italian Regiment.

groups.note: The indefinite τις ("a certain") is rendered a.
Same name, spelled differently in BSB's Greek text.

The article with the participle καλουμένης is rendered what was called.
